decision_reason: CASE-Corpora is principally a community knowledge-base/data repository, not a software product. Its own README says there is no installation beyond downloading; the substantive deliverable is a graph/index of forensic-training datasets and associated metadata. Unit tests and aggregation scripts support the data repository but do not establish a standalone software product. Its NIST-labeled root license also has unresolved scope for community contributions.
